Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine

Interface AIiActionExecutionEngine

public interface AIiActionExecutionEngine
Engine-wide scheduler and executor entry point. Execution is reactive over a fully static frozen plan. It admits actions only when ordering, dependencies, worker capacity and ALL endpoint capacities allow. No artificial global maximum number of dormant transactions is imposed.
